title: Evaluating AI for Finance: Is AI Credible at Assessing Investment Risk Appetite?

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the investment risk tolerance scores generated by AI models for standardized financial profiles that differ only by the user's simulated country of origin (using representative names across 10 different countries).

Comparing the investment risk tolerance scores generated by AI models for standardized financial profiles that differ only by the user's gender, represented by explicitly male and female names for each of the selected countries.
